Saturday, October 24, 2026 | 4:00 PM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX000001LBO52AO/
Join the Worcester 20's & 30's at Phantoms by Firelight: a Mary Shelley's Frankenstein themed event at Old Sturbridge Village. This is an interactive experience where we will explore a 1830's colonial village transformed for Halloween. The event runs from 4:30 PM to 9:00 PM. We will meet in the parking lot before going into the gate and then be free to break up into smaller groups. We will also set an optional meet up time for dinner. Participants are responsible for purchasing their own tickets ($36 as of 10/14). The event is rain or shine. For more information about Phantoms by Firelight please see the OSV website: https://www.osv.org/event/phantoms-by-firelight/

Sunday, October 25, 2026
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX000001JOcL2AW/
Join the Worcester 20s & 30s group for a hike in the Squam Lake region on Sunday, October 25th! We will hike the Squam Traverse, an approximately 12-mile hike along the Crawford-Ridgepole trail. We'll summit four peaks and enjoy views from this trail along the Squam Range.This hike will have approx. 2,850 ft of elevation gain. Our intention is to go at a roughly 1.5 mile per hour pace. Expect to be on trail for the full day.We intend to summit Mts Percival and Morgan, which are both "52 With a View" hikes. This will be a one-way hike with a car spot. We may ask some participants to help with driving members of our group between the trailheads.Sturdy shoes with laces, at least 2 liters of water, nutritious snacks/lunch, and appropriate layers of clothing are required. Participants should be prepared for numerous steep ups and downs and ledgy and rough terrain in sections.No dogs, please. Further details, such as start time and location, will be provided to participants after they complete the required screening form, which will be sent after registering. Hope to have you join us!

events.summary: 20s & 30s October Social at Seven Saws Brewing Company

description.plain:
Wednesday, October 28, 2026 | 6:00 PM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX000001KmBB2A0/
Join the Worcester 20s & 30s for our October social! We'll be at Seven Saws Brewing Company in Holden, MA on Wednesday, October 28th starting at 6pm. Socialize with other young members and leaders from the Worcester Chapter and learn about fun upcoming trips and activities this fall. Seven Saws offers a rotating selection of craft beers, wine, hard cider, hard seltzer and non-alcoholic beverages. Monti Farms food truck will be there from 5-9pm. Feel free to join when you can. Looking forward to seeing you there!20s & 30s is a group within AMC that is dedicated to encouraging people in their 20s and 30s to enjoy the outdoors. Registration is required so the leader can be in touch in case of a change of venue.

Sunday, November 1, 2026 | 4:45 AM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX000001LL452AG/
Join us for a sunrise hike (Sunrike) up Mt. Wachusett (`Chussey)! We will hike 3-4 miles with a total elevation gain of about 750 ft. We plan to spend some time at the summit to enjoy the sunrise, then return to the trailhead near Mountainside Cafe. Feel free to stay for an optional coffee or treat after the hike.The trails will include sections of moderate terrain, and we will be moving at a moderate pace.Proper equipment will be required for this hike, including hiking and weather-appropriate clothing, water, and a headlamp.Please note that this hike will occur the day that Daylight Saving Time ends. Because the time "falls forward," The 4:45 am start time will feel like 5:45 am to your internal clock. Be careful when setting your alarms so you don't show up an hour early!
